entities.name: ClpY ATPase
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A8FD80 from Bacillus pumilus; 466 aa.
ATPase subunit of the HslUV/ClpQ-ClpY proteasome-like degradation complex; has chaperone activity.
Curated annotations include ATP binding, ATP hydrolysis, protein unfolding, and proteasome-activating activity.
Localized to the cytoplasm in the reviewed reference.
Forms a homohexameric ring that caps the ClpQ protease double ring; ATP-dependent complex assembly.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass about 52.4 kDa; theoretical pI 5.49.
Pfam evidence identifies AAA ATPase regions and a ClpB_D2-small-like region, consistent with an AAA+ unfoldase.

entities.name: ClpQ protease
observations: Proteolytic partner of ClpY in the HslUV protease-like complex; ClpY caps the ClpQ double ring.
Complex assembly depends on ATP binding by ClpY, according to reviewed homolog annotation.

entities.name: HslUV protease complex
observations: ATP-dependent proteostasis complex in which ClpY supplies AAA+ ATPase, substrate-unfolding, and protease-activating functions while ClpQ provides the proteolytic chamber.

entities.name: ClpY exact-match assignment
observations: The query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Bacillus pumilus ClpY (A8FD80), with 100% identity and full-length coverage; E-value 1.63e-309.
